quarterly_data.quarter: Gudeng Precision press release: release MessageView (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Gudeng reported August 2026 consolidated group revenue of about NT$8.4 hundred million; cumulative January-August 2026 revenue reached NT$58.9 hundred million, up 31% from NT$44.86 hundred million in the same period last year. The company said its strong performance has continued into the second half, with the overseas share of revenue rising.
quarterly_data.figure: Aug 2026 about NT$8.4 hundred million; Jan-Aug 2026 NT$58.9 hundred million (+31% YoY vs NT$44.86 hundred million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Gudeng Precision press release: release MessageView (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Gudeng said its advanced packaging carriers (SEMI-compliant, customised to packaging processes, for overhead hoist or AGV handling) have built a track record at panel-level packaging fabs and substrate makers after long-term testing, and that as packaging technologies reach mass production its full advanced packaging carrier line has the opportunity to ramp in volume over the next two years in Taiwan, Greater China, Korea and the US. Its plants run injection-moulding equipment from 50 tons to 2,200 tons.
quarterly_data.figure: next two years (company outlook, hedged); 50-2,200 ton injection moulding

quarterly_data.quarter: Gudeng Precision press release: release MessageView (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Gudeng is pushing its expansion plan: the Kurume, Japan plant has been topped out and is expected to complete construction in 2027, then step into mass production according to customer demand; the Arizona (US) aerospace and semiconductor component machining line is expected to start production next quarter, mainly for aerospace demand initially, with the opportunity to expand semiconductor manufacturing capability later. The company said overseas capacity is currently far smaller than in Taiwan.
quarterly_data.figure: Kurume plant completion expected 2027; Arizona line production start expected next quarter
